crossRefs.note: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in order. They entered into the wall which belonged…
The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle…

translations.web: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.
translations.bsb: For they were arranged in three stories, and unlike the courts, they had no pillars. So the upper chambers were set back further than the lower and middle floors.
translations.kjv: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
translations.asv: For they were in three stories, and they had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the uppermost was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
